$comment: WebMCP evals for BlockSmith. Format per developer.chrome.com/docs/ai/webmcp/evals: each case sends `messages` to a model with our tool surface registered and asserts the model chose `expectedCall`. These test tool SELECTION — whether the model reaches for the right tool with the right arguments — which manual testing in the DevTools panel cannot catch. Run against a deployed instance with the evals CLI from GoogleChromeLabs/webmcp-tools.
